scenes.title: With this salve thy wounds I cover,
scenes.place: With this salve thy wounds I cover,
scenes.reentry: Cover well thine injured places; Now the birch-tree shall recover,

scenes.title: Grow more beautiful than ever.”
scenes.place: Grow more beautiful than ever.”
scenes.reentry: True, the birch-tree soon recovered,

scenes.title: Grew more beautiful than ever,
scenes.place: Grew more beautiful than ever,
scenes.reentry: Grew more uniform its branches, And its bole more strong and stately.

scenes.title: Thus it was he tried the balsam,
scenes.place: Thus it was he tried the balsam,
scenes.reentry: Thus the magic salve he tested, Touched with it the splintered sandstone,

scenes.title: Touched the broken blocks of granite,
scenes.place: Touched the broken blocks of granite,
scenes.reentry: Touched the fissures in the mountains, And the broken parts united,

scenes.title: All the fragments grew together
scenes.place: All the fragments grew together
scenes.reentry: Then the young boy quick returning

scenes.title: With the balsam he had finished,
scenes.place: With the balsam he had finished,
scenes.reentry: To the gray-beard gave the ointment, And the boy these measures uttered: “Here I bring the balm of healing,

scenes.title: Wonderful the salve I bring thee;
scenes.place: Wonderful the salve I bring thee;
scenes.reentry: It will join the broken granite, Make the fragments grow together,

scenes.title: Heat the fissures in the mountains,
scenes.place: Heat the fissures in the mountains,
scenes.reentry: And restore the injured birch-tree.”

scenes.title: With his tongue the old man tested,
scenes.place: With his tongue the old man tested,
scenes.reentry: Tested thus the magic balsam, Found the remedy effective,

scenes.title: Found the balm had magic virtues;
scenes.place: Found the balm had magic virtues;
scenes.reentry: Then anointed he the minstrel, Touched the wounds of Wainamoinen,

scenes.title: Touched them with his magic balsam,
scenes.place: Touched them with his magic balsam,
scenes.reentry: With the balm of many virtues; Speaking words of ancient wisdom,

scenes.title: These the words the gray-beard uttered:
scenes.place: These the words the gray-beard uttered:
scenes.reentry: “Do not walk in thine own virtue, Do not work in thine own power,

scenes.title: Walk in strength of thy Creator;
scenes.place: Walk in strength of thy Creator;
scenes.reentry: Do not speak in thine own wisdom, Speak with tongue of mighty Ukko.

scenes.title: In my mouth, if there be sweetness,
scenes.place: In my mouth, if there be sweetness,
scenes.reentry: It has come from my Creator; If my hands are filled with beauty,

scenes.title: All the beauty comes from Ukko.”
scenes.place: All the beauty comes from Ukko.”
scenes.reentry: When the wounds had been anointed,

scenes.title: When the magic salve had touched them,
scenes.place: When the magic salve had touched them,
scenes.reentry: Straightway ancient Wainamoinen Suffered fearful pain and anguish,

scenes.title: Sank upon the floor in torment,
scenes.place: Sank upon the floor in torment,
scenes.reentry: Turning one way, then another, Sought for rest and found it nowhere,

scenes.title: Till his pain the gray-beard banished,
scenes.place: Till his pain the gray-beard banished,
scenes.reentry: Banished by the aid of magic, Drove away his killing torment

scenes.title: To the court of all our trouble,
scenes.place: To the court of all our trouble,
scenes.reentry: To the highest hill of torture, To the distant rocks and ledges,

scenes.title: To the evil-bearing mountains,
scenes.place: To the evil-bearing mountains,
scenes.reentry: To the realm of wicked Hisi. Then he took some silken fabric,

scenes.title: Quick he tore the silk asunder,
scenes.place: Quick he tore the silk asunder,
scenes.reentry: Making equal strips for wrapping, Tied the ends with silken ribbons,

scenes.title: Making thus a healing bandage;
scenes.place: Making thus a healing bandage;
scenes.reentry: Then he wrapped with skilful fingers Wainamoinen’s knee and ankle,

scenes.title: Wrapped the wounds of the magician,
scenes.place: Wrapped the wounds of the magician,
scenes.reentry: And this prayer the gray-beard uttered “Ukko’s fabric is the bandage,

scenes.title: Ukko’s science is the surgeon,
scenes.place: Ukko’s science is the surgeon,
scenes.reentry: These have served the wounded hero, Wrapped the wounds of the magician.

scenes.title: Look upon us, God of mercy,
scenes.place: Look upon us, God of mercy,
scenes.reentry: Come and guard us, kind Creator, And protect us from all evil!

scenes.title: Guide our feet lest they may stumble,
scenes.place: Guide our feet lest they may stumble,
scenes.reentry: Guard our lives from every danger, From the wicked wilds of Hisi.”

scenes.title: Wainamoinen, old and truthful,
scenes.place: Wainamoinen, old and truthful,
scenes.reentry: Felt the mighty aid of magic, Felt the help of gracious Ukko,

scenes.title: Straightway stronger grew in body,
scenes.place: Straightway stronger grew in body,
scenes.reentry: Straightway were the wounds united, Quick the fearful pain departed.

scenes.title: Strong and hardy grew the hero,
scenes.place: Strong and hardy grew the hero,
scenes.reentry: Straightway walked in perfect freedom, Turned his knee in all directions,

scenes.title: Knowing neither pain nor trouble
scenes.place: Knowing neither pain nor trouble
scenes.reentry: Then the ancient Wainamoinen

scenes.title: Raised his eyes to high Jumala,
scenes.place: Raised his eyes to high Jumala,
scenes.reentry: Looked with gratitude to heaven, Looked on high, in joy and gladness,

scenes.title: Then addressed omniscient Ukko,
scenes.place: Then addressed omniscient Ukko,
scenes.reentry: This the prayer the minstrel uttered: “O be praised, thou God of mercy,

scenes.title: Let me praise thee, my Creator,
scenes.place: Let me praise thee, my Creator,
scenes.reentry: Since thou gavest me assistance, And vouchsafed me thy protection,

scenes.title: Healed my wounds and stilled mine anguish,
scenes.place: Healed my wounds and stilled mine anguish,
scenes.reentry: Banished all my pain and trouble, Caused by Iron and by Hisi.

scenes.title: O, ye people of Wainola,
scenes.place: O, ye people of Wainola,
scenes.reentry: People of this generation, And the folk of future ages,

scenes.title: Fashion not in emulation,
scenes.place: Fashion not in emulation,
scenes.reentry: River boat, nor ocean shallop, Boasting of its fine appearance;

scenes.title: God alone can work completion,
scenes.place: God alone can work completion,
scenes.reentry: Give to cause its perfect ending, Never hand of man can find it,

scenes.title: Never can the hero give it,
scenes.place: Never can the hero give it,
scenes.reentry: Ukko is the only Master.”

scenes.reentry: Ilmarinen Forges the Sampo.

scenes.title: Like the winds the steed flies onward,

scenes.title: Makes the highway quickly vanish,
scenes.place: Makes the highway quickly vanish,
scenes.reentry: Dashes on through fen and forest, Over hills and through the valleys,

scenes.title: Over marshes, over mountains,
scenes.place: Over marshes, over mountains,

scenes.title: So a third from morn till evening,
scenes.place: So a third from morn till evening,
scenes.reentry: Till the third day evening brings him To the endless bridge of Osmo,

scenes.title: To the Osmo-fields and pastures,

scenes.reentry: To the plains of Kalevala; When the hero spake as follows: “May the wolves devour the dreamer,

scenes.title: Eat the Laplander for dinner,
scenes.place: Eat the Laplander for dinner,
scenes.reentry: May disease destroy the braggart, Him who said that I should never

scenes.title: See again my much-loved home-land,
scenes.place: See again my much-loved home-land,
scenes.reentry: Nevermore behold my kindred, Never during all my life-time,

scenes.title: Never while the sunshine brightens,
scenes.place: Never while the sunshine brightens,
scenes.reentry: Never while the moonlight glimmers On the meadows of Wainola,

scenes.title: On the plains of Kalevala.”
scenes.place: On the plains of Kalevala.”
scenes.reentry: Then began old Wainamoinen,

scenes.title: Ancient bard and famous singer,
scenes.place: Ancient bard and famous singer,
scenes.reentry: To renew his incantations; Sang aloft a wondrous pine-tree,

scenes.title: Till it pierced the clouds in growing
scenes.place: Till it pierced the clouds in growing
scenes.reentry: With its golden top and branches, Till it touched the very heavens,

scenes.title: Spread its branches in the ether,
scenes.place: Spread its branches in the ether,
scenes.reentry: In the ever-shining sunlight.

scenes.title: Now he sings again enchanting,
scenes.place: Now he sings again enchanting,
scenes.reentry: Sings the Moon to shine forever In the fir-tree’s emerald branches;

scenes.title: In its top he sings the Great Bear
scenes.place: In its top he sings the Great Bear
scenes.reentry: Then he quickly journeys homeward, Hastens to his golden portals,

scenes.title: Head awry and visage wrinkled,
scenes.place: Head awry and visage wrinkled,
scenes.reentry: Crooked cap upon his forehead, Since as ransom he had promised

scenes.title: Ilmarinen, magic artist,
scenes.place: Ilmarinen, magic artist,
scenes.reentry: Thus to save his life from torture On the distant fields of Northland,

scenes.title: In the dismal Sariola
scenes.place: In the dismal Sariola
scenes.reentry: When his stallion he had halted

scenes.title: On the Osmo-field and meadow,
scenes.place: On the Osmo-field and meadow,
scenes.reentry: Quickly rising in his snow-sledge, The magician heard one knocking,

scenes.title: Breaking coal within the smithy,
scenes.place: Breaking coal within the smithy,
scenes.reentry: Beating with a heavy hammer. Wainamoinen, famous minstrel,

scenes.title: Entering the smithy straightway,
scenes.place: Entering the smithy straightway,
scenes.reentry: Found the blacksmith, Ilmarinen, Knocking with his copper hammer.

scenes.title: Ilmarinen spake as follows:
scenes.place: Ilmarinen spake as follows:
scenes.reentry: “Welcome, brother Wainamoinen, Old and worthy Wainamoinen!

scenes.title: Why so long hast thou been absent,
scenes.place: Why so long hast thou been absent,
scenes.reentry: Where hast thou so long been hiding?”

scenes.title: Wainamoinen then made answer,
scenes.place: Wainamoinen then made answer,
scenes.reentry: These the words of the magician: “Long indeed have I been living,

scenes.title: Many dreary days have wandered,
scenes.place: Many dreary days have wandered,
scenes.reentry: Many cheerless nights have lingered, Floating on the cruel ocean,

scenes.title: Weeping in the fens and woodlands
scenes.place: Weeping in the fens and woodlands
scenes.reentry: Of the never-pleasant Northland, In the dismal Sariola;

scenes.title: With the Laplanders I’ve wandered,
scenes.place: With the Laplanders I’ve wandered,
scenes.reentry: With the people filled with witchcraft.”

scenes.title: Promptly answers Ilmarinen,
scenes.place: Promptly answers Ilmarinen,
scenes.reentry: These the words the blacksmith uses: “O thou ancient Wainamoinen,

scenes.title: Famous and eternal singer,
scenes.place: Famous and eternal singer,
scenes.reentry: Tell me of thy journey northward, Of thy wanderings in Lapland,

scenes.title: Of thy dismal journey homeward.”
scenes.place: Of thy dismal journey homeward.”
scenes.reentry: Spake the minstrel, Wainamoinen: “I have much to tell thee, brother,

scenes.title: Listen to my wondrous story:
scenes.place: Listen to my wondrous story:
scenes.reentry: In the Northland lives a virgin, In a village there, a maiden,

scenes.title: That will not accept a lover,
scenes.place: That will not accept a lover,
scenes.reentry: That a hero’s hand refuses, That a wizard’s heart disdaineth;

scenes.title: All of Northland sings her praises,
scenes.place: All of Northland sings her praises,
scenes.reentry: Sings her worth and magic beauty, Fairest maiden of Pohyola,

scenes.title: Daughter of the earth and ocean
scenes.place: Daughter of the earth and ocean
scenes.reentry: From her temples beams the moonlight, From her breast, the gleam of sunshine,

scenes.title: From her forehead shines the rainbow,
scenes.place: From her forehead shines the rainbow,
scenes.reentry: On her neck, the seven starlets, And the Great Bear from her shoulder.

scenes.title: Thou the only skilful blacksmith,
scenes.place: Thou the only skilful blacksmith,
scenes.reentry: Go and see her wondrous beauty, See her gold and silver garments,

scenes.title: See her robed in finest raiment,
scenes.place: See her robed in finest raiment,
scenes.reentry: See her sitting on the rainbow, Walking on the clouds of purple.

scenes.title: Forge for her the magic Sampo,
scenes.place: Forge for her the magic Sampo,
scenes.reentry: Forge the lid in many colors, Thy reward shall be the virgin,

scenes.title: Thou shalt win this bride of beauty;
scenes.place: Thou shalt win this bride of beauty;
scenes.reentry: Go and bring the lovely maiden To thy home in Kalevala.”

scenes.title: Spake the brother, Ilmarinen:
scenes.place: Spake the brother, Ilmarinen:
scenes.reentry: “O thou cunning Wainamoinen, Thou hast promised me already

scenes.title: To the ever-darksome Northland,
scenes.place: To the ever-darksome Northland,
scenes.reentry: Thy devoted head to ransom, Thus to rescue thee from trouble.

scenes.title: I shall never visit Northland,
scenes.place: I shall never visit Northland,
scenes.reentry: Shall not go to see thy maiden, Do not love the Bride of Beauty;

scenes.title: Never while the moonlight glimmers,
scenes.place: Never while the moonlight glimmers,
scenes.reentry: Shall I go to dreary Pohya, To the plains of Sariola,

scenes.title: Where the people eat each other,
scenes.place: Where the people eat each other,
scenes.reentry: Sink their heroes in the ocean, Not for all the maids of Lapland.”

scenes.title: Spake the brother, Wainamoinen:
scenes.place: Spake the brother, Wainamoinen:
scenes.reentry: “I can tell thee greater wonders, Listen to my wondrous story:

scenes.title: I have seen the fir-tree blossom,
scenes.place: I have seen the fir-tree blossom,
scenes.reentry: Seen its flowers with emerald branches, On the Osmo-fields and woodlands;

scenes.title: In its top, there shines the moonlight,
scenes.place: In its top, there shines the moonlight,
scenes.reentry: And the Bear lives in its branches.” Ilmarinen thus made answer: “I cannot believe thy story,

scenes.title: Cannot trust thy tale of wonder,
scenes.place: Cannot trust thy tale of wonder,
scenes.reentry: Till I see the blooming fir-tree, With its many emerald branches,

scenes.title: With its Bear and golden moonlight.”
scenes.place: With its Bear and golden moonlight.”
scenes.reentry: This is Wainamoinen’s answer: “Wilt thou not believe my story?

scenes.title: Come with me and I will show thee
scenes.place: Come with me and I will show thee
scenes.reentry: If my lips speak fact or fiction.”

scenes.title: Quick they journey to discover,
scenes.place: Quick they journey to discover,
scenes.reentry: Haste to view the wondrous fir-tree; Wainamoinen leads the journey,

scenes.title: Ilmarinen closely follows
scenes.place: Ilmarinen closely follows
scenes.reentry: As they near the Osmo-borders, Ilmarinen hastens forward

scenes.title: That he may behold the wonder,
scenes.place: That he may behold the wonder,
scenes.reentry: Spies the Bear within the fir-top, Sitting on its emerald branches,

scenes.title: Spies the gleam of golden moonlight
scenes.place: Spies the gleam of golden moonlight
scenes.reentry: Spake the ancient Wainamoinen:,

scenes.title: These the words the singer uttered:
scenes.place: These the words the singer uttered:
scenes.reentry: “Climb this tree, dear Ilmarinen, And bring down the golden moonbeams,

scenes.title: Bring the Moon and Bear down with thee
scenes.place: Bring the Moon and Bear down with thee
scenes.reentry: From the fir-tree’s lofty branches.”

scenes.title: Ilmarinen, full consenting,
scenes.place: Ilmarinen, full consenting,
scenes.reentry: Straightway climbed the golden fir-tree, High upon the bow of heaven,

scenes.title: Thence to bring the golden moonbeams,
scenes.place: Thence to bring the golden moonbeams,
scenes.reentry: Thence to bring the Bear of heaven, From the fir-tree’s topmost branches.

scenes.title: Thereupon the blooming fir-tree
scenes.place: Thereupon the blooming fir-tree
scenes.reentry: Spake these words to Ilmarinen: “O thou senseless, thoughtless hero,

scenes.title: Thou hast neither wit nor instinct;
scenes.place: Thou hast neither wit nor instinct;
scenes.reentry: Thou dost climb my golden branches, Like a thing of little judgment,

scenes.title: Thus to get my pictured moonbeams,
scenes.place: Thus to get my pictured moonbeams,
scenes.reentry: Take away my silver starlight, Steal my Bear and blooming branches.”

scenes.title: Quick as thought old Wainamoinen
scenes.place: Quick as thought old Wainamoinen
scenes.reentry: Sang again in magic accents, Sang a storm-wind in the heavens,

scenes.title: Sang the wild winds into fury,
scenes.place: Sang the wild winds into fury,
scenes.reentry: And the singer spake as follows: “Take, O storm-wind, take the forgeman,

scenes.title: Carry him within thy vessel,
scenes.place: Carry him within thy vessel,
scenes.reentry: Quickly hence, and land the hero On the ever-darksome Northland,

scenes.title: On the dismal Sariola.”
scenes.place: On the dismal Sariola.”
scenes.reentry: Now the storm-wind quickly darkens,

scenes.title: Quickly piles the air together,
scenes.place: Quickly piles the air together,
scenes.reentry: Makes of air a sailing vessel, Takes the blacksmith, Ilmarinen,

scenes.title: Fleetly from the fir-tree branches,
scenes.place: Fleetly from the fir-tree branches,
scenes.reentry: Toward the never-pleasant Northland, Toward the dismal Sariola.

scenes.title: Through the air sailed Ilmarinen,
scenes.place: Through the air sailed Ilmarinen,
scenes.reentry: Fast and far the hero travelled, Sweeping onward, sailing northward,

scenes.title: Riding in the track of storm-winds,
scenes.place: Riding in the track of storm-winds,
scenes.reentry: O’er the Moon, beneath the sunshine, On the broad back of the Great Bear,

scenes.title: Till he neared Pohyola’s woodlands,
scenes.place: Till he neared Pohyola’s woodlands,
scenes.reentry: Neared the homes of Sariola, And alighted undiscovered,

scenes.title: Was not noticed by the hunters,
scenes.place: Was not noticed by the hunters,
scenes.reentry: Was not scented by the watch-dogs.

scenes.title: Louhi, hostess of Pohyola,
scenes.place: Louhi, hostess of Pohyola,

scenes.title: Thus addresses Ilmarinen,
scenes.place: Thus addresses Ilmarinen,
scenes.reentry: As she spies the hero-stranger: “Who art thou of ancient heroes,

scenes.title: Who of all the host of heroes,
scenes.place: Who of all the host of heroes,
scenes.reentry: Coming here upon the storm-wind, O’er the sledge-path of the ether,

scenes.title: Scented not by Pohya’s watch-dogs?”
scenes.place: Scented not by Pohya’s watch-dogs?”
scenes.reentry: This is Ilmarinen’s answer: “I have surely not come hither

scenes.title: To be barked at by the watch-dogs,
scenes.place: To be barked at by the watch-dogs,
scenes.reentry: At these unfamiliar portals, At the gates of Sariola.”

scenes.title: Thereupon the Northland hostess
scenes.place: Thereupon the Northland hostess
scenes.reentry: Asks again the hero-stranger: “Hast thou ever been acquainted

scenes.title: With the blacksmith of Wainola,
scenes.place: With the blacksmith of Wainola,
scenes.reentry: With the hero, Ilmarinen, With the skilful smith and artist?

scenes.title: Long I’ve waited for his coming,
scenes.place: Long I’ve waited for his coming,
scenes.reentry: Long this one has been expected, On the borders of the Northland,

scenes.title: Here to forge for me the Sampo.”
scenes.place: Here to forge for me the Sampo.”

scenes.title: With the blacksmith, Ilmarinen,
scenes.place: With the blacksmith, Ilmarinen,
scenes.reentry: I myself am Ilmarinen, I, the skilful smith and artist.”

scenes.title: Louhi, hostess of the Northland,
scenes.place: Louhi, hostess of the Northland,

scenes.place: These the words that Louhi utters:

scenes.reentry: Deck thy hair with rarest jewels, Pearls upon thy swelling bosom,

scenes.title: Now the daughter of the Northland,
scenes.place: Now the daughter of the Northland,

scenes.title: Ruddy cheeks and charming visage,

scenes.title: To her home in Sariola,

scenes.title: From the tips of white-swan feathers,

scenes.reentry: From the milk of greatest virtue, From a single grain of barley,

scenes.title: Ere the earth had a beginning.”

scenes.reentry: Thereupon the magic blacksmith

scenes.place: Lemminkainen’s mother answered:
scenes.reentry: “Then thy journey is not ended, Greater dangers still await thee,

scenes.title: Still await thy reckless footsteps,

scenes.title: Thou wilt reach the Court of Pohya,

scenes.title: Rises from the earth to heaven,
scenes.place: Rises from the earth to heaven,
scenes.reentry: Back again to earth returning; Double spears are used for railings,

scenes.title: On each spear are serpents winding,

scenes.title: Play their long tails in the sunlight,

scenes.reentry: Hissing lizards, venomed serpents, Jump and writhe upon the rampart,

scenes.title: Turn their horrid heads to meet thee;
scenes.place: Turn their horrid heads to meet thee;

scenes.title: With their pliant tongues of venom,

scenes.title: Than the hero of the islands.”

scenes.place: Handsome hero, Kaukomieli:

scenes.title: Can appease the wrath of serpents,
scenes.place: Can appease the wrath of serpents,

scenes.title: Plowed the adder-fields of Northland;

scenes.reentry: While my hands were unprotected, Held the serpents in my fingers,

scenes.title: Drove the adders to Manala,

scenes.reentry: On my hands the blood of serpents, On my feet the fat of adders.

scenes.title: Never will thy hero stumble
scenes.place: Never will thy hero stumble
scenes.reentry: On the serpents of the Northland; With my heel I’ll crush the monsters,

scenes.title: In the hamlets of Pohyola;

scenes.place: Sank beneath its angry billows;

scenes.place: There to-day thou wouldst be sleeping,

scenes.title: Shouldst thou gain Pohyola’s chambers,
scenes.place: Shouldst thou gain Pohyola’s chambers,

scenes.place: There thy head will rest forever,

scenes.title: Cowards too may give attention;
scenes.place: Cowards too may give attention;

scenes.title: Bring to me my battle-armor,
scenes.place: Bring to me my battle-armor,

scenes.title: Keep the old man’s blade from rusting;
scenes.place: Keep the old man’s blade from rusting;

scenes.title: Long and constantly been weeping,
scenes.place: Long and constantly been weeping,

scenes.place: Then he took his mail of copper,

scenes.reentry: Tried its edge upon the sorb-tree; In his hand the blade was bended,

scenes.title: Like the limber boughs of willow,
scenes.place: Like the limber boughs of willow,
scenes.reentry: Like the juniper in summer. Spake the hero, Lemminkainen: “There is none in Pohya’s hamlets,

scenes.title: In the courts of Sariola,
scenes.place: In the courts of Sariola,
scenes.reentry: That with me can measure broadswords, That can meet this blade ancestral.”

scenes.title: From the nail he took a cross-bow,
scenes.place: From the nail he took a cross-bow,
scenes.reentry: Took the strongest from the rafters, Spake these words in meditation: “I shall recognize as worthy,

scenes.title: Recognize that one a hero
scenes.place: Recognize that one a hero
scenes.reentry: That can bend this mighty cross-bow, That can break its magic sinews,

scenes.title: In the hamlets of Pohyola.”
scenes.place: In the hamlets of Pohyola.”
scenes.reentry: Lemminkainen, filled with courage,

scenes.title: Girds himself in suit of battle,

scenes.title: I am going to the feasting,
scenes.place: I am going to the feasting,
scenes.reentry: To the banquet-fields of Lempo.”

scenes.title: Quick obeys the faithful servant,
scenes.place: Quick obeys the faithful servant,
scenes.reentry: Hitches well the noble war-horse, Quick prepares the fire-red stallion,

scenes.title: Speaks these words when all is ready:
scenes.place: Speaks these words when all is ready:
scenes.reentry: “I have done what thou hast hidden, Ready harnessed is the charger,

scenes.title: Waiting to obey his master.”
scenes.place: Waiting to obey his master.”
scenes.reentry: Comes the hour of the departing

scenes.title: Of the hero, Lemminkainen,
scenes.place: Of the hero, Lemminkainen,
scenes.reentry: Right hand ready, left unwilling, All his anxious fingers pain him,

scenes.title: Till at last in full obedience,
scenes.place: Till at last in full obedience,
scenes.reentry: All his members give permission; Starts the hero on his journey,

scenes.title: While the mother gives him counsel,
scenes.place: While the mother gives him counsel,
scenes.reentry: At the threshold of the dwelling, At the highway of the court-yard: “Child of courage, my beloved,

scenes.title: Son of strength, my wisdom-hero,
scenes.place: Son of strength, my wisdom-hero,
scenes.reentry: If thou goest to the feasting, Shouldst thou reach the great carousal,

scenes.title: Drink thou only a half a cupful,

scenes.title: Give the worse half to another,
scenes.place: Give the worse half to another,
scenes.reentry: To another more unworthy; In the lower half are serpents,

scenes.title: Worms, and frogs, and hissing lizards,
scenes.place: Worms, and frogs, and hissing lizards,
scenes.reentry: Feeding on the slimy bottom.”

scenes.title: Furthermore she tells her hero,
scenes.place: Furthermore she tells her hero,
scenes.reentry: Gives her son these sage directions, On the border of the court-yard,

scenes.title: At the portals farthest distant:

scenes.title: Occupy but half the settle,
scenes.place: Occupy but half the settle,
scenes.reentry: Take but half a stride in walking, Give the second half to others,

scenes.title: To another less deserving;
scenes.place: To another less deserving;
scenes.reentry: Only thus thou’lt be a hero, Thus become a son immortal;

scenes.title: In the guest-rooms look courageous,
scenes.place: In the guest-rooms look courageous,
scenes.reentry: Bravely move about the chambers, In the gatherings of heroes,

scenes.title: With the hosts of magic valor.”
scenes.place: With the hosts of magic valor.”
scenes.reentry: Thereupon wild Lemminkainen

scenes.title: Quickly leaped upon the cross-bench
scenes.place: Quickly leaped upon the cross-bench
scenes.reentry: Of his battle-sledge of wonder, Raised his pearl-enamelled birch-rod,

scenes.title: Snapped his whip above his charger,
scenes.place: Snapped his whip above his charger,
scenes.reentry: And the steed flew onward fleetly, Galloped on his distant journey.

scenes.place: He had travelled little distance,

scenes.reentry: Screaming from his throat of splendor: “Though thou art wild Lemminkainen,

scenes.title: Drives them to the eagle’s fire-mouth,

scenes.place: On his journey to Pohyola

scenes.title: Come and listen to my playing,

scenes.reentry: To the harp’s entrancing measures, To my songs of joy and gladness.”

scenes.title: Then the singer of Wainola
scenes.place: Then the singer of Wainola
scenes.reentry: Took the harp of his creation, Quick adjusting, sweetly tuning,

scenes.title: Deftly plied his skillful fingers
scenes.place: Deftly plied his skillful fingers
scenes.reentry: To the strings that he had fashioned. Now was gladness rolled on gladness,

scenes.title: And the harmony of pleasure
scenes.place: And the harmony of pleasure
scenes.reentry: Echoed from the hills and mountains: Added singing to his playing,

scenes.title: Out of joy did joy come welling,
scenes.place: Out of joy did joy come welling,
scenes.reentry: Now resounded marvelous music, All of Northland stopped and listened.

scenes.title: Every creature in the forest,
scenes.place: Every creature in the forest,
scenes.reentry: All the beasts that haunt the woodlands, On their nimble feet came bounding,

scenes.title: Came to listen to his playing,

scenes.title: Merrily from birch to aspen;

scenes.title: To the harp of Wainamoinen
scenes.place: To the harp of Wainamoinen

scenes.title: From the water-cliffs the salmon,

scenes.reentry: These the words the sea-king uttered: “Never have I heard such playing,

scenes.title: Never heard such strains of music,
scenes.place: Never heard such strains of music,

scenes.title: This sweet singer, Wainamoinen.”
scenes.place: This sweet singer, Wainamoinen.”
scenes.reentry: Satko’s daughters from the blue-deep,

scenes.title: Sisters of the wave-washed ledges,

scenes.reentry: On the colored strands were sitting, Smoothing out their sea-green tresses

scenes.title: With the combs of molten silver,

scenes.reentry: With their silver-handled brushes, Brushes forged with golden bristles.

scenes.title: When they hear the magic playing,
scenes.place: When they hear the magic playing,
scenes.reentry: Hear the harp of Wainamoinen, Fall their brushes on the billows,

scenes.title: Fall their combs with silver handles
scenes.place: Fall their combs with silver handles
scenes.reentry: To the bottom of the waters, Unadorned their heads remaining,

scenes.title: And uncombed their sea-green tresses
scenes.place: And uncombed their sea-green tresses
scenes.reentry: Came the hostess of the waters,

scenes.title: Ancient hostess robed in flowers,
scenes.place: Ancient hostess robed in flowers,
scenes.reentry: Rising from her deep sea-castle, Swimming to the shore in wonder,

scenes.title: Listened to the minstrel’s playing,
scenes.place: Listened to the minstrel’s playing,
scenes.reentry: To the harp of Wainamoinen. As the magic tones re-echoed,

scenes.title: As the singer’s song out-circled,
scenes.place: As the singer’s song out-circled,
scenes.reentry: Sank the hostess into slumber, On the rocks of many colors,

scenes.title: On her watery couch of joyance,
scenes.place: On her watery couch of joyance,
scenes.reentry: Deep the sleep that settled o’er her.

scenes.title: Wainamoinen, ancient minstrel,
scenes.place: Wainamoinen, ancient minstrel,
scenes.reentry: Played one day and then a second, Played the third from morn till even.

scenes.title: There was neither man nor hero,
scenes.place: There was neither man nor hero,
scenes.reentry: Neither ancient dame, nor maiden, Not in Metsola a daughter,

scenes.title: Whom he did not touch to weeping;
scenes.place: Whom he did not touch to weeping;
scenes.reentry: Wept the young, and wept the aged, Wept the mothers, wept the daughters

scenes.title: Wept the warriors and heroes
scenes.place: Wept the warriors and heroes
scenes.reentry: At the music of his playing, At the songs of the magician.

scenes.title: Wainamoinen’s tears came flowing,
scenes.place: Wainamoinen’s tears came flowing,
scenes.reentry: Welling from the master’s eyelids, Pearly tear-drops coursing downward,

scenes.title: Larger than the whortle-berries,
scenes.place: Larger than the whortle-berries,
scenes.reentry: Finer than the pearls of ocean, Smoother than the eggs of moor-hens,

scenes.title: Brighter than the eyes of swallows
scenes.place: Brighter than the eyes of swallows
scenes.reentry: From his eyes the tear-drops started, Flowed adown his furrowed visage,

scenes.title: Falling from his beard in streamlets,
scenes.place: Falling from his beard in streamlets,
scenes.reentry: Trickled on his heaving bosom, Streaming o’er his golden girdle,

scenes.title: Coursing to his garment’s border,
scenes.place: Coursing to his garment’s border,
scenes.reentry: Then beneath his shoes of ermine, Flowing on, and flowing ever, Part to earth for her possession, Part to water for her portion.

scenes.title: As the tear-drops fall and mingle,
scenes.place: As the tear-drops fall and mingle,
scenes.reentry: Form they streamlets from the eyelids Of the minstrel, Wainamoinen,

scenes.title: To the blue-mere’s sandy margin,
scenes.place: To the blue-mere’s sandy margin,
scenes.reentry: To the deeps of crystal waters, Lost among the reeds and rushes.

scenes.title: Spake at last the ancient minstrel:
scenes.place: Spake at last the ancient minstrel:
scenes.reentry: “Is there one in all this concourse, One in all this vast assembly

scenes.title: That can gather up my tear-drops
scenes.place: That can gather up my tear-drops
scenes.reentry: From the deep, pellucid waters?”

scenes.title: Thus the younger heroes answered,
scenes.place: Thus the younger heroes answered,
scenes.reentry: Answered thus the bearded seniors: “There is none in all this concourse,

scenes.title: None in all this vast assembly,
scenes.place: None in all this vast assembly,
scenes.reentry: That can gather up thy tear-drops From the deep, pellucid waters.”

scenes.title: Spake again wise Wainamoinen:
scenes.place: Spake again wise Wainamoinen:
scenes.reentry: “He that gathers up my tear-drops From the deeps of crystal waters

scenes.title: Shall receive a beauteous plumage.”
scenes.place: Shall receive a beauteous plumage.”
scenes.reentry: Came a raven, flying, croaking,

scenes.title: And the minstrel thus addressed him:
scenes.place: And the minstrel thus addressed him:
scenes.reentry: “Bring, O raven, bring my tear-drops From the crystal lake’s abysses;

scenes.title: I will give thee beauteous plumage,
scenes.place: I will give thee beauteous plumage,
scenes.reentry: Recompense for golden service.” But the raven failed his master.

scenes.title: Came a duck upon the waters,
scenes.place: Came a duck upon the waters,
scenes.reentry: And the hero thus addressed him: “Bring, O water-bird, my tear-drops;

scenes.title: Often thou dost dive the deep-sea,
scenes.place: Often thou dost dive the deep-sea,
scenes.reentry: Sink thy bill upon the bottom Of the waters thou dost travel;

scenes.title: Dive again my tears to gather,
scenes.place: Dive again my tears to gather,
scenes.reentry: I will give thee beauteous plumage, Recompense for golden service.”

scenes.title: Thereupon the duck departed,
scenes.place: Thereupon the duck departed,
scenes.reentry: Hither, thither, swam, and circled, Dived beneath the foam and billow,

scenes.title: Gathered Wainamoinen’s tear-drops
scenes.place: Gathered Wainamoinen’s tear-drops
scenes.reentry: From the blue-sea’s pebbly bottom, From the deep, pellucid waters;

scenes.title: Brought them to the great magician,
scenes.place: Brought them to the great magician,
scenes.reentry: Beautifully formed and colored, Glistening in the silver sunshine,

scenes.title: Glimmering in the golden moonlight,
scenes.place: Glimmering in the golden moonlight,
scenes.reentry: Many-colored as the rainbow, Fitting ornaments for heroes,

scenes.title: Jewels for the maids of beauty
scenes.place: Jewels for the maids of beauty
scenes.reentry: This the origin of sea-pearls, And the blue-duck’s beauteous plumage.

scenes.place: Rune Xlii

scenes.place: Ilmarinen led the rowers

scenes.title: Led the rowers on the other

scenes.title: Steered his vessel o’er the waters,
scenes.place: Steered his vessel o’er the waters,
scenes.reentry: Through the foam and angry billows To Pohyola’s place of landing,

scenes.title: To the cylinders of copper,
scenes.place: To the cylinders of copper,
scenes.reentry: Where the war-ships lie at anchor.

scenes.title: When they had arrived at Pohya,
scenes.place: When they had arrived at Pohya,
scenes.reentry: When their journey they had ended, On the land they rolled their vessel,

scenes.title: On the copper-banded rollers,
scenes.place: On the copper-banded rollers,

scenes.title: Of the dismal Sariola
scenes.place: Of the dismal Sariola
scenes.reentry: Louhi, hostess of the Northland,

scenes.title: Thus addressed the stranger-heroes:
scenes.place: Thus addressed the stranger-heroes:
scenes.reentry: “Magic heroes of Wainola, What the tidings ye are bringing

scenes.title: To the people of my village?”
scenes.place: To the people of my village?”

scenes.title: Gave this answer to the hostess:
scenes.place: Gave this answer to the hostess:
scenes.reentry: “All the hosts of Kalevala Are inquiring for the Sampo,

scenes.title: Asking for the lid in colors;
scenes.place: Asking for the lid in colors;
scenes.reentry: Hither have these heroes journeyed To divide the priceless treasure.”

scenes.title: Thus the hostess spake in answer:
scenes.place: Thus the hostess spake in answer:
scenes.reentry: “No one would divide a partridge, Nor a squirrel, with three heroes;

scenes.title: Wonderful the magic Sampo,
scenes.place: Wonderful the magic Sampo,
scenes.reentry: Plenty does it bring to Northland; And the colored lid re-echoes

scenes.title: From the copper-bearing mountains,
scenes.place: From the copper-bearing mountains,
scenes.reentry: From the stone-berg of Pohyola, To the joy of its possessors.”

scenes.title: Wainamoinen, ancient minstrel,
scenes.place: Wainamoinen, ancient minstrel,
scenes.reentry: Thus addressed the ancient Louhi: “If thou wilt not share the Sampo,

scenes.title: Give to us an equal portion,
scenes.place: Give to us an equal portion,
scenes.reentry: We will take it to Wainola, With its lid of many colors,

scenes.title: Take by force the hope of Pohya.”
scenes.place: Take by force the hope of Pohya.”
scenes.reentry: Thereupon the Northland hostess

scenes.title: Angry grew and sighed for vengeance;
scenes.place: Angry grew and sighed for vengeance;
scenes.reentry: Called her people into council, Called the hosts of Sariola,

scenes.title: Heroes with their trusted broadswords,
scenes.place: Heroes with their trusted broadswords,
scenes.reentry: To destroy old Wainamoinen With his people of the Northland.

scenes.title: Wainamoinen, wise and ancient,

scenes.reentry: Hastened to his harp of fish-bone, And began his magic playing;

scenes.title: All of Pohya stopped and listened,

scenes.reentry: Every warrior was silenced By the notes of the magician;

scenes.title: Peaceful-minded grew the soldiers,
scenes.place: Peaceful-minded grew the soldiers,
scenes.reentry: All the maidens danced with pleasure, While the heroes fell to weeping,

scenes.title: And the young men looked in wonder
scenes.place: And the young men looked in wonder
scenes.reentry: Wainamoinen plays unceasing,

scenes.title: Plays the maidens into slumber,
scenes.place: Plays the maidens into slumber,
scenes.reentry: Plays to sleep the young and aged, All of Northland sleeps and listens.

scenes.title: Wise and wondrous Wainamoinen,
scenes.place: Wise and wondrous Wainamoinen,
scenes.reentry: The eternal bard and singer, Searches in his pouch of leather,

scenes.title: Draws therefrom his slumber-arrows,
scenes.place: Draws therefrom his slumber-arrows,
scenes.reentry: Locks the eyelids of the sleepers, Of the heroes of Pohyola,

scenes.title: Sings and charms to deeper slumber
scenes.place: Sings and charms to deeper slumber
scenes.reentry: All the warriors of the Northland. Then the heroes of Wainola

scenes.title: Hasten to obtain the Sampo,
scenes.place: Hasten to obtain the Sampo,
scenes.reentry: To procure the lid in colors From the copper-bearing mountains.

scenes.title: From behind nine locks of copper,
scenes.place: From behind nine locks of copper,
scenes.reentry: In the stone-berg of Pohyola.

scenes.title: Wainamoinen, ancient minstrel,
scenes.place: Wainamoinen, ancient minstrel,
scenes.reentry: Then began his wondrous singing, Sang in gentle tones of magic,

scenes.title: At the entrance to the mountain,
scenes.place: At the entrance to the mountain,
scenes.reentry: At the border of the stronghold; Trembled all the rocky portals,

scenes.title: And the iron-banded pillars

scenes.reentry: Fell and crumbled at his singing.

scenes.title: Ilmarinen, magic blacksmith,
scenes.place: Ilmarinen, magic blacksmith,

scenes.title: And the bolts flew back by magic,

scenes.title: Spake the minstrel Wainamoinen:
scenes.place: Spake the minstrel Wainamoinen:
scenes.reentry: “O thou daring Lemminkainen, Friend of mine in times of trouble,

scenes.title: Enter thou within the mountain,
scenes.place: Enter thou within the mountain,
scenes.reentry: Bring away the wondrous Sampo, Bring away the lid in colors!”

scenes.title: Quick the reckless Lemminkainen,
scenes.place: Quick the reckless Lemminkainen,
scenes.reentry: Handsome hero, Kaukomieli, Ever ready for a venture,

scenes.title: Hastens to the mountain-caverns,
scenes.place: Hastens to the mountain-caverns,
scenes.reentry: There to find the famous Sampo, There to get the lid in colors;

scenes.title: Strides along with conscious footsteps,
scenes.place: Strides along with conscious footsteps,
scenes.reentry: Thus himself he vainly praises: “Great am I and full of glory,

scenes.title: Wonder-hero, son of Ukko,
scenes.place: Wonder-hero, son of Ukko,
scenes.reentry: I will bring away the Sampo, Turn about the lid in colors,

scenes.title: Turn it on its magic hinges!”
scenes.place: Turn it on its magic hinges!”
scenes.reentry: Lemminkainen finds the wonder,

scenes.title: Finds the Sampo in the mountain,

scenes.reentry: Labors long with strength heroic, Tugs with might and main to turn it;

scenes.title: Motionless remains the treasure,
scenes.place: Motionless remains the treasure,
scenes.reentry: Deeper sinks the lid in colors, For the roots have grown about it,

scenes.title: Grown nine fathoms deep in sand-earth
scenes.place: Grown nine fathoms deep in sand-earth
scenes.reentry: Lived a mighty ox in Northland,

scenes.title: Powerful in bone and sinew,
scenes.place: Powerful in bone and sinew,
scenes.reentry: Beautiful in form and color, Horns the length of seven fathoms,

scenes.title: Mouth and eyes of wondrous beauty
scenes.place: Mouth and eyes of wondrous beauty
scenes.reentry: Lemminkainen, reckless hero,

scenes.title: Harnesses the ox in pasture,
scenes.place: Harnesses the ox in pasture,
scenes.reentry: Takes the master-plow of Pohya, Plows the roots about the Sampo,

scenes.title: Plows around the lid in colors,
scenes.place: Plows around the lid in colors,

scenes.reentry: Into billowy deeps and dangers. Spake the blacksmith, Ilmarinen: “Whither shall we take the Sampo,

scenes.title: Where the sword will not molest it.”
scenes.place: Where the sword will not molest it.”
scenes.reentry: Then the minstrel, Wainamoinen,

scenes.title: Joyful, left the Pohya borders,
scenes.place: Joyful, left the Pohya borders,

scenes.title: Turn thy back upon the strangers,
scenes.place: Turn thy back upon the strangers,
scenes.reentry: Turn thou to my distant country! Rock, O winds, my magic vessel,

scenes.title: Homeward drive my ship, O billows,
scenes.place: Homeward drive my ship, O billows,

scenes.title: On this vast expanse of waters!
scenes.place: On this vast expanse of waters!
scenes.reentry: Give me of thine oars, O Ahto, Lend thine aid, O King of sea-waves,

scenes.title: Guide as with thy helm in safety,
scenes.place: Guide as with thy helm in safety,
scenes.reentry: Lay thy hand upon the rudder, And direct our war-ship homeward;

scenes.title: Let the hooks of metal rattle
scenes.place: Let the hooks of metal rattle
scenes.reentry: O’er the surging of the billows, On the white-capped waves’ commotion.”
